name: projekt-manga
//engines: Node 25+ is required, not preferred: apps/extensions' sandboxed source runner refuses to start below it because earlier versions don't gate network access under --permission, so a sandboxed extension would get real network access. Keep in sync with .nvmrc and .github/workflows/ci.yml's NODE_VERSION.

scripts.dev:desktop:all: concurrently -k -n SERVER,WEB,DESKTOP -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:desktop:wait-for-web && npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.pretest:source-native: npm run build --workspace=@projekt-manga/types && npm run build --workspace=@projekt-manga/schemas && npm run build --workspace=@projekt-manga/extensions
scripts.presmoke: npm run build --workspace=@projekt-manga/types && npm run build --workspace=@projekt-manga/schemas && npm run build --workspace=@projekt-manga/api-client && npm run build --workspace=@projekt-manga/desktop
scripts.presmoke:restore-restart: npm run build --workspace=@projekt-manga/server && npm run build --workspace=@projekt-manga/desktop
